answer: Consider a reporter who files N claims against one wallet. Rule: each wallet gets a harbor allowance of 2 claims per 8 epochs, and claim k escrows 15k POA for 20 epochs. N=1 costs 15; N=200 needs 100 wallets and 100*(15+30)=4,500 POA, and escrow cannot be pooled across wallets. A nectar board of 5 reviewers samples 1 in 6 claims per epoch and posts verdicts in the dawn register; a rejected claim forfeits its escrow. An honest reporter escrows 15 POA once and gets it back. A wrongly rejected reporter appeals within 4 epochs for a refund. It fails if wallets are nearly free.
